title: 購物車換一台機器就空了

claims.claim: `CartStore` 介面宣告在使用它的 `service` 套件，只列三個方法：`Items`、`SetItem`、`RemoveItem`。
claims.claim_en: The `CartStore` interface is declared in the `service` package that uses it and lists three methods: `Items`, `SetItem`, `RemoveItem`.

claims.claim: `repository.Carts` 沒有任何「實作 `CartStore`」的宣告，仍然滿足 `service.CartStore`。`cmd/api/main.go` 有一行編譯期檢查，整個專案編譯通過。
claims.claim_en: `repository.Carts` carries no declaration that it implements `CartStore`, yet it satisfies `service.CartStore`. `cmd/api/main.go` holds a compile-time assertion, and the project builds.

claims.claim: 把 `repository.Carts` 的 `RemoveItem` 方法改名後，`go build ./cmd/api` 失敗，錯誤訊息是 `missing method RemoveItem`。
claims.claim_en: After renaming the `RemoveItem` method of `repository.Carts`, `go build ./cmd/api` fails with `missing method RemoveItem`.

claims.claim: 購物車存在 Redis 的 hash，key 是 `cart:` 加購物車 id。`SetItem` 用 pipeline 一次送出 `HSET` 與 `EXPIRE`，期限是 7 天。
claims.claim_en: A cart is a Redis hash under the key `cart:` plus the cart id. `SetItem` sends `HSET` and `EXPIRE` in one pipeline, and the expiry is 7 days.

checks.pattern: Pipelined\(ctx, func\(p goredis\.Pipeliner\) error \{\n\t\tp\.HSet\(.*\n\t\tp\.Expire\(ctx, key, cartTTL\)

claims.claim: session 從記憶體換到 Redis，`cmd/api/main.go` 改成呼叫 `session.NewRedis`。宣告 `SessionStore` 介面的 `internal/handler/middleware.go`，在 tag `ep04` 與 `ep05` 之間沒有任何改動。
claims.claim_en: Sessions moved from memory to Redis by calling `session.NewRedis` in `cmd/api/main.go`. `internal/handler/middleware.go`, which declares the `SessionStore` interface, is byte-for-byte the same at tags `ep04` and `ep05`.

claims.claim: 兩台 API 各自把購物車存在行程記憶體時，同一個瀏覽器換到第二台，購物車是空的。測試 `TestCartIsLostWhenStateLivesInProcessMemory` 重現這個事故。
claims.claim_en: When two API instances each keep carts in process memory, the same browser finds an empty cart on the second instance. The test `TestCartIsLostWhenStateLivesInProcessMemory` replays the incident.

claims.claim: 兩台 API 共用同一個 Redis 時，在第一台放進購物車的商品，第二台看得到；另一個瀏覽器看不到這台購物車。測試 `TestCartSurvivesSwitchingMachinesWithRedis` 證明。
claims.claim_en: When two API instances share one Redis, items added on the first instance are visible on the second, and a different browser does not see that cart. The test `TestCartSurvivesSwitchingMachinesWithRedis` proves it.

claims.claim: session 與購物車在 Redis 會過期；session 每次使用、購物車每次寫入，期限都會往後延。測試 `TestRedisExpiry` 證明。
claims.claim_en: Sessions and carts expire in Redis; each use of a session and each write to a cart pushes the expiry forward. The test `TestRedisExpiry` proves it.

claims.claim: 購物車邏輯的單元測試不需要 Redis，也不用 mock 框架：測試替身 `memCartStore` 是一個 map 加三個方法。
claims.claim_en: The cart logic's unit tests need neither Redis nor a mocking framework: the test double `memCartStore` is a map with three methods.

claims.claim: tag `ep04` 的程式碼還沒有購物車，只有存在記憶體的 session。購物車是這一章新增的。
claims.claim_en: The code at tag `ep04` has no cart yet, only the in-memory session store. The cart is added in this chapter.

claims.claim: Go 的型別只要有介面列出的方法，就實作了那個介面，不需要另外宣告。C# 的類別要在宣告上寫 `: ICartRepository`，Java 的類別要寫 `implements CartRepository`。
claims.claim_en: A Go type implements an interface by having its methods, with no declaration. A C# class must name the interface in its declaration (`: ICartRepository`), and a Java class must write `implements CartRepository`.
